title: Holistic Synthesis: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets (John J. Murphy)
prerequisites: Completion or foundational understanding of individual book chapters
Desire to unify isolated tools into a complete system
learningOutcomes: Perceive the book as an unbroken dialectical chain of inventions.
Understand why each tool was invented to solve the prior tool's failure.
Master the integration of macro trend, micro entry, confirmation, and risk control.
Apply the 8 Inviolable Laws of the author to live markets.

sections.title: The Isolated Tool Trap & The Dialectical Chain
sections.pedagogicalObjective: Expose the disaster of trading single tools in isolation.

sections.title: The 4 Evolutionary Eras of the Book
sections.pedagogicalObjective: Map the macro architectural progression of the author's teachings.

sections.title: Regime Specialization & Order Flow Confirmation
sections.pedagogicalObjective: Show how indicators and confirmation tools complement each other.

sections.title: The 8 Inviolable Laws of the Author
sections.pedagogicalObjective: Synthesize the entire course into 8 permanent laws.
